title: Generated baseball cards for my deckbuilding roguelike. Do they look too ai generated?
author: somedonkusgames
selftext:
Basically the idea is each card has a fielding and a batting side depending on what your team is currently doing. the overall concept is pretty simple, just try and get your bat/def higher than the opponent to either get on base or get them out. Each player has a position, and a batting type (fly ball, grounder, or bunt), which will tell them how well they will do on the matchup with the card or cards they are facing. 

Feedback im looking for: is the card art too ai generated? is the info on the card clear? is there a better way to do these matchups? 

feel free to playtest the demo for DUGOUT here as well and let me know any feedback:

[https://somekindadonkus.itch.io/dugout](https://somekindadonkus.itch.io/dugout)

comments.author: Foreign-Quote-53
comments.body:
To me, yes. But I’ve seen a lot worse.

They all have a little bit of that yellow in them to me. And the cartoon style.

replies.author: somedonkusgames
replies.body: thanks for the feedback, ill try and see if regenerating them with a fixed color pallet works better. i wanted to make them a pixel art cartoonish style, but ai tends to make a lot of the faces look too detailed or similar. its hard to give reference images without the model copying the reference too much.

replies.author: Foreign-Quote-53
replies.body: I think make it cartoon pixel art is fine, it’s just this particular style of cartoon pixel art is very AI. I don’t have a great way to describe why that is exactly though lol

replies.author: somedonkusgames
replies.body: i totally get what you mean

comments.author: somedonkusgames
comments.body: Generated the card art with GPT Astra. the card frames were generated with astra then turned into svgs.

comments.author: DocHolidayPhD
comments.body: These are about as AI looking as you can get.

replies.author: NorberAbnott
replies.body: If you didn't even notice, then you're not spending enough time crafting each individual card, and it shows. You can get rid of the 'ai generated look' by not asking ai to mass produce this stuff.

comments.author: Internal-Capital7471
comments.body: They all reuse the same posing and framing, which makes it much more like ai
